products.name: Wistia
products.note: Video hosting AI; analytics; marketing video; data privacy; engagement tracking

profile_text.body:
Wistia describes itself as a video marketing platform for businesses, offering tools to create, host, market, and measure video content. Its features span webinar hosting, marketing automation integrations with HubSpot, Marketo, and Pardot, in-video lead capture forms, SEO support, engagement tracking, and a public API for building custom video experiences. The platform also includes recording, editing, and team collaboration tools.

On the AI side, Wistia offers a feature called Wistia Remix, described as an AI video editing tool for repurposing existing video content. The company also publishes resources on AI video marketing trends, indicating a focus on helping marketers apply AI within their video strategies.

The site's held facts classify Wistia's product under video hosting AI, analytics, marketing video, data privacy, and engagement tracking categories. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
